# Awesome Launch80 List — full catalog

Generated from catalog/. Fields absent from a record are unknown. Hard gates: architectures,
gpu_count_min, min_vram_gb, os. Maturity/verification describe how much to trust each entry.

## aiter-cdna2
name: davetha/aiter-cdna2
outcome: Binary-patches AMD AITER (officially CDNA3+) to unlock its fast paths on CDNA2.
use_it_if: You have MI210/MI250X-class GPUs and want the AITER kernels that most MI210 performance work depends on.
kind: kernel_library | maturity: unverified | verification: unverified
hardware: cdna2 | gpu_models: mi210, mi250x
provides: custom_kernels
repository: https://github.com/davetha/aiter-cdna2
builders: davetha

## alloyium
name: Alloyium-ai/alloyium
outcome: Real-time communication between agents using existing Claude/ChatGPT subscriptions.
use_it_if: You want multiple agents on your existing subscriptions to talk to each other in real time.
kind: agent_harness | maturity: unverified | verification: unverified
hardware: any
repository: https://github.com/Alloyium-ai/alloyium
builders: atcsecure

## betterbench
name: GGZ14/BetterBench
outcome: The community's go-to benchmark suite for vLLM and llama.cpp endpoints.
use_it_if: You have a running endpoint and want numbers comparable with what others post in the Discord.
kind: benchmark_tool | maturity: unverified | verification: unverified
hardware: any
software: runtimes: vllm, llama_cpp
provides: benchmarking
repository: https://github.com/GGZ14/BetterBench
builders: The_Candle_Watcher
notes: Includes a graded code corpus, --runs N, and --quick mode.

## capicua-vllm-rocm-rdna4

## hipengine
name: shisa-ai/hipEngine
outcome: From-scratch RX 7900 XTX inference engine with ~5.7x near-lossless KV compression and MTP.
use_it_if: You have an RX 7900 XTX and want maximum context (up to 232K at Q4_K_M) from a single card.
kind: inference_engine | maturity: unverified | verification: author_reported
hardware: rdna3 | gpu_models: rx7900xtx
software: runtimes: custom_engine
provides: kv_compression, mtp, speculative_decoding, long_context
supports: quantizations: gguf_q4_k_m | topologies: single_gpu
repository: https://github.com/shisa-ai/hipEngine
builders: lhl
notes: v0.5.0 adds DMS KV compression (author reports 100% top-1, 0.001 KLD). Shared in #rx7900.

# Start-here paths

- r9700-endpoint: Run a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint on one R9700 (1× Radeon AI PRO R9700) -> start_with=zzpanic-gfx1201-launchers then=malicz-gfx1201-launchers,vllm-radiance. why: The most-recommended starting point in #r9700; malicz adds a full Docker + MXFP4 setup on the Radiance base.
- r9700-throughput: Maximize throughput on R9700s (1–2× Radeon AI PRO R9700) -> start_with=vllm-mxfp4 then=magiccodingman-vllm-radiance,vllm-radlight. why: Highest prefill/decode numbers reported for R9700 in this list. caveat: Numbers are author-reported and concurrency is not stated; benchmark your own endpoint before comparing.
- rdna4-sglang: Use SGLang instead of vLLM on RDNA4 (2× Radeon AI PRO R9700) -> start_with=sglang-2x-r9700. why: The community's starting point for SGLang on RDNA4.
- rdna3-single-card: Run quantized models on one RX 7900 XTX (1× RX 7900 XTX (24 GB)) -> start_with=llama-cpp-rdna-boosts then=hipengine. why: The best llama.cpp uplift many 7900 XTX owners saw; hipEngine fits up to 232K context at Q4_K_M.
- rdna2-v620: Serve models on Radeon Pro V620s (1–4× Radeon Pro V620) -> start_with=rocmfp4-llama then=vllm-rdna2-recipe,vllm-rdna2-qwen,v620-toolbox. why: rocmfp4-llama is the recipe members use on V620; the vLLM path suits multi-card rigs.
- moe-small-rig: Serve a MoE model that does not fit in VRAM (Any vLLM-capable rig) -> start_with=vllm-expert-cache. why: Only expert-offload project listed. caveat: Target GPU architectures are not yet recorded.
- cdna-datacenter: Run fast inference on MI210 / MI100 (Instinct MI210 (CDNA2) or MI100 (CDNA1)) -> start_with=mi210-llm-stack then=mi210-vllm,aiter-cdna2,int8-vllm. why: mi210-llm-stack maps models to serving tiers first; int8-vllm is the MI100 path.
- multi-gpu-build: Build a multi-GPU box with working P2P (2× GPUs on an EPYC-class host) -> start_with=dual-r9700-vllm-proxmox then=vllm-radiance-p2p. why: Documents passthrough, P2P and the RCCL patches needed to make P2P work; vllm-radiance-p2p is the RDNA3 equivalent.
- benchmark-endpoint: Benchmark an existing endpoint (Any) -> start_with=betterbench. why: The community's go-to benchmark suite; use it so your numbers are comparable to others'.
- intel-arc: Use an Intel Arc GPU (Arc B580) -> start_with=krea2-intel-arc-b580 then=vllm-expert-cache. why: Only Arc datapoint listed; vllm-expert-cache includes Intel porting docs. caveat: No LLM-serving recipe for Arc is listed yet.
- monitor-gpus: Monitor my GPUs while tuning (R9700 or V620) -> start_with=r9v then=v620-toolbox. why: R9V is actively maintained in-server for the R9700.
